title: Latest UIFlow2 firmware full-device / full-peripheral multi-angle validation and issue triage

source.issue: none: direct user request (pull latest UIFlow2 firmware, test every device/peripheral from latest docs, file issues first)

hardware.reason: All execution used QEMU/Device Service virtual devices; no physical hardware, RF, power, optical, electrical or mechanical validation.

firmware.source: M5Burner public API and pinned official GitHub releases, fetched 2026-11-05

execution.environment: macOS arm64; agent-owned isolated Device Service instances (multiple ports/state dirs); QEMU Xtensa/C6 canonical runtime sha256 0e16a9bcd86b588dae6b3e3b523dfb8610a9eca37c50c141cce5f2ceb4612068 (some early boot cases on 6d9af027e2f744208fc2503128f1772f436d7ca7358f9e53be597bc76800f39d)
execution.session_ids: per-case session ids recorded in ignored .work/uiflow-latest-20261105/*/results.json

checks.name: boot_flash_device_service
checks.values: 19/29 devices PASS in 2 cold rounds; 20 FAIL cases = 10 classic devices known-blocker (qemu-esptool)

checks.name: device_ui_matrix
checks.values: 11 PASS / 15 FAIL / 4 BLOCKED / 3 NOT RUN; all 15 failures reproduced twice

checks.name: peripheral_matrix
checks.values: 60 PASS / 8 FAIL out of 68; 8/8 reproduced twice; root causes: ED2208 partial window, AXP2101 charge state, 2 stale expectations

checks.name: unit_battery
checks.values: 104 catalog Units covered; 93 PASS + 9 PASS-after-rerun + 2 tracked EXPECTED_BLOCKED; 0 FAIL; 46 NOT RUN cases (time box), 9 units without batch runner

checks.name: docs_driven_tests
checks.values: 25 cases / 135 checks; 19 PASS / 6 BLOCKED(infra); 12 confirmed uiflow-docs mismatches reproduced twice

checks.name: github_issues_filed
checks.values: 14 issues (#172-#185) with firmware/runtime identities and repro evidence

checks.name: internal_uiflow_issues_filed
checks.values: 10 new internal UIFlow2 doc issues + 2 evidence comments on existing issues

checks.name: physical_hardware
checks.reason: no physical devices; virtual-device results cannot establish RF/power/acoustics/optics/electrics/mechanics

notes: Latest firmware cache is ignored platform/.cache/firmware; derived VFS-layout adapters and all raw serial/frame/evidence stay in ignored .work/uiflow-latest-20261105/.
Tracked repo tree untouched; all simulator/tool defects are tracked by GitHub issues #172-#184 for follow-up agents.
